caption:
KLAY'S QUARTER 🎮🏀 January 23, 2015 vs the Kings. Third quarter.

• 13-for-13 from the field
• 9-for-9 from three
• 37 points in one quarter, still the NBA record
• 52 for the night

Can anyone ever break it? 👇
